declarations.name: setup.byte_values
declarations.statement:
Definition byte_values (zs : list Z) : list val :=
  (λ z : Z, LitV (LitInt z)) <$> zs.

declarations.name: setup.byte_map
declarations.statement: Definition byte_map (p : loc) (zs : list Z) : gmap loc val := interval_map p (byte_values zs).

declarations.name: setup.pair_outside
declarations.statement: Definition pair_outside h p pad q key := h ∖ (byte_map p pad ∪ byte_map q key).

declarations.name: setup.pair_setup
declarations.statement: Definition pair_setup (e : expr) : expr := (Skip;; Skip;; Share;; e)%E.

declarations.name: setup.shared_key_view
declarations.statement:
Definition shared_key_view (key : list Z) (q : loc) tid κ : iProp Σ :=
    tctx_interp tid +[#q ◁ &shr{κ} (bytes_ty (length key))]
      -[((q, repeat [] (length key)), bytes_of_list key)].

declarations.name: setup.shared_key_view_own
declarations.statement:
Lemma shared_key_view_own key q tid κ :
    shared_key_view key q tid κ ⊣⊢
    ∃ d, ⧖d ∗ ty_own (&shr{κ} (bytes_ty (length key)))
      ((q, repeat [] (length key)), bytes_of_list key) d d tid [FVal #q].

declarations.name: setup.pair_lifetimes_recombine
declarations.statement:
Lemma pair_lifetimes_recombine κpad κkey :
    llctx_interp [κpad ⊑ₗ []] ∗ llctx_interp [κkey ⊑ₗ []] ⊣⊢
    llctx_interp [κpad ⊑ₗ []; κkey ⊑ₗ []].

declarations.name: setup.raw_pair_payload
declarations.statement:
Lemma raw_pair_payload h p pad q key :
    Forall (λ z, 0 ≤ z < 256) pad → Forall (λ z, 0 ≤ z < 256) key →
    (∀ (i : nat) (z : Z), pad !! i = Some z → h !! (p +ₗ i) = Some #z) →
    (∀ (i : nat) (z : Z), key !! i = Some z → h !! (q +ₗ i) = Some #z) →
    byte_map p pad ##ₘ byte_map q key →
    initial_fragments h ⊣⊢
      (p, repeat [] (length pad)) #↦!∗ (FVal <$> byte_values pad) ∗
      (q, repeat [] (length key)) #↦!∗ (FVal <$> byte_values key) ∗
      initial_fragments (pair_outside h p pad q key).

declarations.name: setup.model_key_share
declarations.statement:
Lemma model_key_share key q tid κ :
    llft_ctx -∗ proph_ctx -∗ uniq_ctx -∗ time_ctx -∗ elctx_interp [] -∗
    llctx_interp [κ ⊑ₗ []] -∗
    invctx_interp tid ⊤ [] (InvCtx [] static AtomicClosed) -∗
    ⧖1 -∗ model_reference key q tid κ -∗
    WP Share {{ _, llctx_interp [κ ⊑ₗ []] ∗
      invctx_interp tid ⊤ [] (InvCtx [] static AtomicClosed) ∗
      shared_key_view key q tid κ }}.

declarations.name: setup.raw_pair_model_context_wp
declarations.statement:
Theorem raw_pair_model_context_wp e h p pad q key (Φ : val → iProp Σ) k :
    Closed [] e →
    Forall (λ z, 0 ≤ z < 256) pad → Forall (λ z, 0 ≤ z < 256) key →
    (∀ (i : nat) (z : Z), pad !! i = Some z → h !! (p +ₗ i) = Some #z) →
    (∀ (i : nat) (z : Z), key !! i = Some z → h !! (q +ₗ i) = Some #z) →
    byte_map p pad ##ₘ byte_map q key →
    (∀ (TG : typeG Σ) tid κpad κkey,
      @type_lrustGS Σ TG = Outer → κpad ≠ llft_empty → κkey ≠ llft_empty →
      llft_ctx -∗ proph_ctx -∗ uniq_ctx -∗ time_ctx -∗ elctx_interp [] -∗
      llctx_interp [κpad ⊑ₗ []] -∗ llctx_interp [κkey ⊑ₗ []] -∗
      invctx_interp tid ⊤ [] (InvCtx [] static AtomicClosed) -∗
      model_reference pad p tid κpad -∗ shared_key_view key q tid κkey -∗
      initial_fragments (pair_outside h p pad q key) -∗ £k -∗ WP e @ ⊤ {{ Φ }}) →
    initial_fragments h -∗ £(1+k) -∗ time_ctx -∗
    WP pair_setup e @ ⊤ {{ Φ }}.

declarations.name: setup.raw_pair_model_observed
declarations.statement:
Theorem raw_pair_model_observed e h p pad q key
      (Φ : lrustGS Σ → val → iProp Σ) (φ : val → state → Prop) k :
    Closed [] e →
    Forall (λ z, 0 ≤ z < 256) pad → Forall (λ z, 0 ≤ z < 256) key →
    (∀ (i : nat) (z : Z), pad !! i = Some z → h !! (p +ₗ i) = Some #z) →
    (∀ (i : nat) (z : Z), key !! i = Some z → h !! (q +ₗ i) = Some #z) →
    byte_map p pad ##ₘ byte_map q key →
    (∀ (Outer : lrustGS Σ) (TG : typeG Σ) tid κpad κkey,
      @type_lrustGS Σ TG = Outer → κpad ≠ llft_empty → κkey ≠ llft_empty →
      llft_ctx -∗ proph_ctx -∗ uniq_ctx -∗ time_ctx -∗ elctx_interp [] -∗
      llctx_interp [κpad ⊑ₗ []] -∗ llctx_interp [κkey ⊑ₗ []] -∗
      invctx_interp tid ⊤ [] (InvCtx [] static AtomicClosed) -∗
      model_reference pad p tid κpad -∗ shared_key_view key q tid κkey -∗
      initial_fragments (pair_outside h p pad q key) -∗ £k -∗
      @wp (iProp Σ) expr val stuckness
        (@wp' HasLc lrust_lang Σ (@lrustGS_irisGS Σ Outer)) NotStuck ⊤ e (Φ Outer)) →
    (∀ (Outer : lrustGS Σ) σ v,
      heap_ctx σ -∗ Φ Outer v ={⊤,∅}=∗ ⌜φ v σ⌝) →
    adequate NotStuck (pair_setup e) (initialized_state h) φ.

declarations.name: controls.byte_map_disjoint_iff
declarations.statement:
Lemma byte_map_disjoint_iff p pad q key :
  byte_map p pad ##ₘ byte_map q key ↔
  ∀ (i j : nat), (i < length pad)%nat → (j < length key)%nat → p +ₗ i ≠ q +ₗ j.

declarations.name: controls.byte_map_empty_alias
declarations.statement: Lemma byte_map_empty_alias p pad : byte_map p pad ##ₘ byte_map p [].

declarations.name: controls.byte_map_same_block_gap
declarations.statement:
Lemma byte_map_same_block_gap (base : loc) pad key gap :
  (0 ≤ gap)%Z →
  byte_map (base +ₗ 1) pad ##ₘ
    byte_map (base +ₗ (1 + length pad + gap)) key.

declarations.name: controls.shared_key_aliases
declarations.statement:
Lemma shared_key_aliases key q tid κ :
    shared_key_view key q tid κ ⊣⊢
    shared_key_view key q tid κ ∗ shared_key_view key q tid κ.

declarations.name: controls.pair_setup_outside_observed
declarations.statement:
Theorem pair_setup_outside_observed h p pad q key :
  Forall (λ z, 0 ≤ z < 256) pad → Forall (λ z, 0 ≤ z < 256) key →
  (∀ (i : nat) (z : Z), pad !! i = Some z → h !! (p +ₗ i) = Some #z) →
  (∀ (i : nat) (z : Z), key !! i = Some z → h !! (q +ₗ i) = Some #z) →
  byte_map p pad ##ₘ byte_map q key →
  adequate NotStuck (pair_setup #0) (initialized_state h)
    (λ v σ, v = #0 ∧ frame_observed σ (pair_outside h p pad q key)).

declarations.name: controls.empty_key_same_address_setup_observed
declarations.statement:
Theorem empty_key_same_address_setup_observed h p pad :
  Forall (λ z, 0 ≤ z < 256) pad →
  (∀ (i : nat) (z : Z), pad !! i = Some z → h !! (p +ₗ i) = Some #z) →
  adequate NotStuck (pair_setup #0) (initialized_state h)
    (λ v σ, v = #0 ∧ frame_observed σ (pair_outside h p pad p [])).

declarations.name: controls.strict_interior_pair_setup_observed
declarations.statement:
Theorem strict_interior_pair_setup_observed base (prefix middle suffix : list val)
    pad key f :
  prefix ≠ [] → middle ≠ [] → suffix ≠ [] →
  interval_map base (prefix ++ byte_values pad ++ middle ++ byte_values key ++ suffix) ##ₘ f →
  Forall (λ z, 0 ≤ z < 256) pad → Forall (λ z, 0 ≤ z < 256) key →
  let h := interval_map base (prefix ++ byte_values pad ++ middle ++ byte_values key ++ suffix) ∪ f in
  let p := base +ₗ length prefix in
  let q := base +ₗ length (prefix ++ byte_values pad ++ middle) in
  adequate NotStuck (pair_setup #0) (initialized_state h)
    (λ v σ, v = #0 ∧ frame_observed σ (pair_outside h p pad q key)).

declarations.name: shared_read.shared_key_view
declarations.statement:
Definition shared_key_view n κ q (x : ~~(bytes_sort n)) d g tid : iProp Σ :=
    ty_own (&shr{κ} (bytes_ty n)) ((q, repeat [] n), x) d g tid [FVal #q].

declarations.name: shared_read.shared_key_view_persistent
declarations.statement:
Instance shared_key_view_persistent n κ q x d g tid :
    Persistent (shared_key_view n κ q x d g tid).

declarations.name: shared_read.shared_key_cap
declarations.statement:
Definition shared_key_cap n κ q (x : ~~(bytes_sort n)) d g tid : iProp Σ :=
    shared_key_view n κ q x d g tid ∗
    ⌜Forall (λ z, 0 ≤ z < 256) (byte_list n x)⌝.

declarations.name: shared_read.shared_key_cap_persistent
declarations.statement:
Instance shared_key_cap_persistent n κ q x d g tid :
    Persistent (shared_key_cap n κ q x d g tid).

declarations.name: shared_read.bytes_index_guard
declarations.statement:
Lemma bytes_index_guard n (x : ~~(bytes_sort n)) tid q (i : nat) (z : Z) F :
    byte_list n x !! i = Some z →
    ⊢ (q ↦[^ repeat [] n]!∗ ty_phys (bytes_ty n) x tid)
      &&{F}&&> ((q +ₗ i) ↦[^ []] #z).

declarations.name: shared_read.shared_key_prepare
declarations.statement:
Lemma shared_key_prepare n κ q x d g tid E L :
    lctx_lft_alive E L κ →
    llft_ctx -∗ elctx_interp E -∗ llctx_interp L -∗
    shared_key_view n κ q x d g tid -∗ £(g+1) ={⊤}=∗
    llctx_interp L ∗ shared_key_cap n κ q x d g tid.

declarations.name: shared_read.shared_key_read
declarations.statement:
Lemma shared_key_read n κ q x d g tid E L (i : nat) (Frame : iProp Σ) :
    (i < n)%nat → lctx_lft_alive E L κ →
    llft_ctx -∗ elctx_interp E -∗ llctx_interp L -∗
    shared_key_cap n κ q x d g tid -∗ Frame -∗ £(g+1) -∗
    WP Read ScOrd #(q +ₗ i) @ ⊤ {{ v, ∃ z : Z,
      ⌜byte_list n x !! i = Some z ∧ v = #z ∧ 0 ≤ z < 256⌝ ∗
      llctx_interp L ∗ shared_key_cap n κ q x d g tid ∗ Frame }}.

declarations.name: shared_read.shared_view_read
declarations.statement:
Lemma shared_view_read n κ q x d g tid E L (i : nat) (Frame : iProp Σ) :
    (i < n)%nat → lctx_lft_alive E L κ →
    llft_ctx -∗ elctx_interp E -∗ llctx_interp L -∗
    shared_key_view n κ q x d g tid -∗ Frame -∗ £(2*(g+1)) -∗
    WP Read ScOrd #(q +ₗ i) @ ⊤ {{ v, ∃ z : Z,
      ⌜byte_list n x !! i = Some z ∧ v = #z ∧ 0 ≤ z < 256⌝ ∗
      llctx_interp L ∗ shared_key_view n κ q x d g tid ∗ Frame }}.

declarations.name: observation.shared_key_heap_observe
declarations.statement:
Lemma shared_key_heap_observe n κ q x d g tid E L (i : nat) σ (Frame : iProp Σ) :
    (i < n)%nat → lctx_lft_alive E L κ →
    llft_ctx -∗ elctx_interp E -∗ llctx_interp L -∗
    shared_key_cap n κ q x d g tid -∗ Frame -∗ heap_ctx σ -∗ £(g+1)
    ={⊤}=∗ heap_ctx σ ∗ llctx_interp L ∗
      shared_key_cap n κ q x d g tid ∗ Frame ∗
      ⌜∃ (z : Z) r, byte_list n x !! i = Some z ∧
        σ.1 !! (q +ₗ i) = Some (RSt r, #z) ∧ 0 ≤ z < 256⌝.

declarations.name: instances.empty_key_has_no_index
declarations.statement: Lemma empty_key_has_no_index (i : nat) : ¬ (i < 0)%nat.

declarations.name: instances.shared_view_depth_zero
declarations.statement:
Lemma shared_view_depth_zero n κ q x g tid :
    shared_key_view n κ q x 0 g tid ⊢ False.

declarations.name: instances.shared_cap_duplicate
declarations.statement:
Lemma shared_cap_duplicate n κ q x d g tid :
    shared_key_cap n κ q x d g tid ⊢
      shared_key_cap n κ q x d g tid ∗ shared_key_cap n κ q x d g tid.

declarations.name: instances.shared_read_same_alias
declarations.statement:
Lemma shared_read_same_alias n κ q x d g tid E L (i : nat) (Frame : iProp Σ) :
    (i < n)%nat → lctx_lft_alive E L κ →
    llft_ctx -∗ elctx_interp E -∗ llctx_interp L -∗
    shared_key_cap n κ q x d g tid -∗
    (shared_key_cap n κ q x d g tid ∗ Frame) -∗ £(g+1) -∗
    WP Read ScOrd #(q +ₗ i) @ ⊤ {{ v, ∃ z : Z,
      ⌜byte_list n x !! i = Some z ∧ v = #z ∧ 0 ≤ z < 256⌝ ∗
      llctx_interp L ∗ shared_key_cap n κ q x d g tid ∗
      (shared_key_cap n κ q x d g tid ∗ Frame) }}.

declarations.name: instances.shared_read129
declarations.statement:
Lemma shared_read129 κ q (x : ~~(bytes_sort 129)) tid E L (Frame : iProp Σ) :
    lctx_lft_alive E L κ →
    llft_ctx -∗ elctx_interp E -∗ llctx_interp L -∗
    shared_key_cap 129 κ q x 1 0 tid -∗ Frame -∗ £1 -∗
    WP Read ScOrd #(q +ₗ 128) @ ⊤ {{ v, ∃ z : Z,
      ⌜byte_list 129 x !! 128%nat = Some z ∧ v = #z ∧ 0 ≤ z < 256⌝ ∗
      llctx_interp L ∗ shared_key_cap 129 κ q x 1 0 tid ∗ Frame }}.

declarations.name: instances.list_shared_read
declarations.statement:
Lemma list_shared_read zs κ q tid E L (i : nat) (z : Z) d g (Frame : iProp Σ) :
    zs !! i = Some z → lctx_lft_alive E L κ →
    llft_ctx -∗ elctx_interp E -∗ llctx_interp L -∗
    shared_key_view (length zs) κ q (bytes_of_list zs) d g tid -∗ Frame -∗ £(2*(g+1)) -∗
    WP Read ScOrd #(q +ₗ i) @ ⊤ {{ v,
      ⌜v = #z ∧ 0 ≤ z < 256⌝ ∗ llctx_interp L ∗
      shared_key_view (length zs) κ q (bytes_of_list zs) d g tid ∗ Frame }}.

declarations.name: session.key_reader
declarations.statement:
Definition key_reader n κ q (x : ~~(bytes_sort n)) d g tid (R : iProp Σ) : iProp Σ :=
    □ (∀ (i : nat) (Frame : iProp Σ), ⌜(i < n)%nat⌝ -∗ R -∗ Frame -∗ £(g+1) -∗
      WP Read ScOrd #(q +ₗ i) @ ⊤ {{ v, ∃ z : Z,
        ⌜byte_list n x !! i = Some z ∧ v = #z ∧ 0 ≤ z < 256⌝ ∗
        R ∗ shared_key_cap n κ q x d g tid ∗ Frame }}).

declarations.name: session.key_reader_persistent
declarations.statement:
Instance key_reader_persistent n κ q x d g tid R :
    Persistent (key_reader n κ q x d g tid R).

declarations.name: session.key_reader_read
declarations.statement:
Lemma key_reader_read n κ q x d g tid R (i : nat) (Frame : iProp Σ) :
    (i < n)%nat → key_reader n κ q x d g tid R -∗ R -∗ Frame -∗ £(g+1) -∗
    WP Read ScOrd #(q +ₗ i) @ ⊤ {{ v, ∃ z : Z,
      ⌜byte_list n x !! i = Some z ∧ v = #z ∧ 0 ≤ z < 256⌝ ∗
      R ∗ shared_key_cap n κ q x d g tid ∗ Frame }}.

declarations.name: session.shared_key_reader_session
declarations.statement:
Lemma shared_key_reader_session n κ q x d g tid E L :
    lctx_lft_alive E L κ →
    llft_ctx -∗ elctx_interp E -∗ llctx_interp L -∗
    shared_key_view n κ q x d g tid -∗ £(g+1) ={⊤}=∗
      ∃ (R G : iProp Σ), ⌜Timeless R ∧ Timeless G⌝ ∗
      R ∗ G ∗ shared_key_cap n κ q x d g tid ∗
      (G &&{↑NllftG}&&> llctx_interp L) ∗
      key_reader n κ q x d g tid R ∗
      (R -∗ G ={⊤}=∗ llctx_interp L).
